prompt:
Transform any uploaded photo into a standalone, high-end, minimalist-style poster. Use an overall 3:4 vertical composition, divided into top and bottom zones with a strict 1:1 height ratio, each occupying 50% of the canvas.

TOP HALF: Retain the original photo - preserving its main structure, authentic texture, natural lighting, and original color atmosphere - while applying only subtle adjustments to evoke an artistic photography or gallery-exhibition aesthetic. To fit the format, naturally extend the sky, ground, or background, but do not stretch, distort, or alter the main subject.

BOTTOM HALF: Abstract the subject's most recognizable outline and structure using simple geometric shapes, flat color blocks, fine line work, and negative space to create a minimalist, vector-style graphic. Avoid realistic illustrations or complex details, yet preserve the subject's key features so the original remains instantly recognizable.

COLOR & COMPOSITION: Derive the color palette from the image above and incorporate a few horizontal lines, vertical lines, or abstract circular elements. Use a beige or light-colored background with ample negative space; center the main subject within a balanced, restrained composition. You may add a simple English title.

STYLE: Draw stylistic inspiration from international design, architectural posters, art exhibition posters, and luxury visual systems to achieve a high-end, modern, elegant, and artistic look; avoid common filters, cheap or low-quality aesthetics, cartoon styles, digital effects, or generic template vibes.
